reviews.text: Great app but I have some suggestions. I love how cute it looks and how it goes into detail about different phases of your period. I have learned so much from it! Everything I need. I’ve tried most cycle trackers and landed on Musa because it’s exactly what I was looking for. It gives you information on your cycles, recommendation, explanations of symptoms and more. I mainly needed something to track my symptoms and my period after stopping bc. But the addition of learning more about each cycle you’re in plus recommendations really sets it apart from other trackers. My only gripe is waiting to see the developers add other ways to feed your dragon. As some other reviews, would love to add journaling, gratitude, maybe a goal you’re working on- can all be great ways to feed your dragon if you don’t choose to meditate that day. Hopefully an update comes soon!

Potential to be great. The app has been useful in tracking cycles and gives great tips with each symptom. The one thing I would add onto the app is the option to implement a contraceptive cycle. For example, with birth control pills, it stops ovulation from happening so the cycle is different than a normal period. Instead noting the ovulation phase of a cycle, it’s better to have a prediction tracking for birth control cycles. As well as being able to note events like breakthrough bleeding or a potential missed pill. The Queendom is cute and all but it would be nice to also have a public forum for women who want to reach out and ask questions or tips that helped others. Overall, it’s a cute app but I do believe it has a lot of potential. 🥰

On its way to perfection!. I’ve never found a meditation app that I’ve stuck with regularly until Musa, that is! 💜 This cycle tracker is as cute as it is informative, with 3-minute meditations that are easy to incorporate into my day-to-day. It typically runs well, with minor crashes here and there, but has already improved in the month I’ve been using it. This app makes a point to protect my data, which I appreciate tremendously. 

What I love:

1. Meditations are short, simple, and effective. I ADORE the breathing techniques taught during these meditations and find myself using them throughout the day!

2. The app itself is adorable and easy to navigate. I love the widget with my dragon and her reminder to meditate! Having your dragon run away if you miss meditation is a great motivator for this daily habit.

3. Logging symptoms is easy. I like the way the app suggests the most common symptoms for whatever phase of the menstrual cycle you’re in.

4. The “goddesses” are AI-generated images of yourself for each phase of your cycle. Kinda neat! I thought it was silly at first, if I’m honest, but I do think they’re some merit to seeing yourself recreated as a “goddess” while you honor your menstrual cycle and body. 

5. The daily “hormonscope” is a nice touch. It explains how you may be feeling given your menstruation cycle in a cheeky and fun way. The brief hormonscope is always validating to read and is especially grounding before meditation.

My suggestions for improvement are:

1. FAQ Section. This would be especially helpful for new users. For example, I can’t seem to find any info on the full dragon growth cycle. When are they done growing? When do you get the next dragon?

2. A way to view and analyze the aggregate of symptoms I log for each day/cycle. Perhaps being able to toggle this on/off and by symptom in the Period tab would work? I’d like to see a bigger picture of what symptoms I feel and when. 

3. There is a bug that sometimes prevents Musa from saving my meditation progress for the day, meaning I have to redo it. I do worry that I’ll lose my dragon by mistake someday because of this bug!

4. Make a catalogue of the meditations so we can select ones that work best for us or revisit them later. 

5. The Queendom is a cute concept but currently without much use. Maybe include a way to send our dragon to friends with some daily encouragement?

6. No idea how well this app does without internet access. I’m about to go off the grid for a week and am nervous I may lose my dragon if I lose internet connection!
